data.name: Infosys Ltd
data.about: Infosys Ltd provides consulting, technology, outsourcing and next-generation digital services to enable clients to execute strategies for their digital transformation.[1]It is the 2nd largest Information Technology company in India behind TCS.[2]

target.quote: Strong year-to-date performance and robust deal wins have enabled us to revise our revenue guidance for FY'26 upward to 3% to 3.5%.

rows.explanation: Revenue grew 9.6% over the full year, exceeding the 3%–3.5% guided.

target.quote: Our operating margin guidance remains at 20% to 22%.

rows.explanation: Operating margin reached 23.7% for the full year, topping the 20%–22% guided.

target.quote: And of course, there will be a 50 bps impact on account of the acquisitions that we have called out.

rows.explanation: Acquisition impact on EBITDA margin remained ≈ 0.5% for FY27, as guided.

target.quote: Considering lower-than-expected Q1 revenues and revised view of the rest of the year, we are revising our revenue guidance to 1.5% to 3%.

rows.explanation: Revenue grew 12.3% over the partial year, within the 1.5%–3% guided range.

target.quote: We expect effective tax rate for the year to be in the range of 29% to 30%.

rows.explanation: Guided effective tax rate 29%–30% for FY27; not checkable from reported financials.

target.quote: Margin guidance is maintained at 20% to 22%.

rows.explanation: Guided operating margin 20%–22% for FY27; not checkable from reported financials.

target.quote: We expect Onsite mix excluding new acquisitions to reduce by 75 bps to 1% for the year.

rows.explanation: Guided onsite mix reduction (excluding new acquisitions) 0.8%–1% for FY27; not checkable from reported financials.

target.quote: As we look forward, as I said earlier as well in the call, we will have 0.75% to 1% reduction in onsite mix, so that is the tailwind.

rows.explanation: Guided onsite mix reduction 0.8%–1% for FY27; not checkable from reported financials.

data.what_it_does: Infosys sells AI-first business consulting and technology services to global enterprises, helping them unlock AI value at scale and accelerate business transformation. Its offerings span software application development and maintenance, IT consulting, and next-generation digital services, with over 95% of revenue derived from these services. The company serves clients across 84 countries and derives 97.40% of turnover from exports (in relation to India).

segments.name: Retail, Consumer Packaged Goods, Transportation and Logistics

bull.text: Infosys delivered 9.6% revenue growth in FY'26 against guidance of 3-3.5%, with operating margin of 23.7% exceeding the 20-22% guidance range.

The company generated ₹189,336 Cr revenue and ₹30,788 Cr PAT TTM with 3-year CAGR of 6.8% and 6.9% respectively, ROCE of 40%, debt-to-equity of 0.09, and operating cash flow to PAT of 1.15 over three years.
Quarterly revenue showed consistent sequential growth from ₹45,479 Cr in Dec 2025 to ₹49,244 Cr in Sep 2026, while PAT remained robust between ₹7,775 Cr and ₹8,509 Cr.

bear.text: Management cut FY'26 revenue guidance to 1.5-3% in July 2026 from 3-3.5% in January 2026, citing lower-than-expected Q1 revenues.

Acquisitions are expected to dilute operating margin by approximately 50 bps in the near term and 0.7% on a full-year annualized basis, while a large European manufacturing client's revenue reduction will further impact margin by 0.75-1%.
Operating margin has slightly declined from 23.9% three years ago to 23.7% currently, despite the company guiding for 20-22% and consistently delivering above that range.
